values.note: Booking site, Oct 2026 to Jun 2027, weeknights and a Friday-Saturday stay alike: non-electric sites $28.99 a night (every one tagged as fitting RVs from 20-30 ft up to the 60-70 ft class), electric sites $39.99.

fees.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7989230 'Twin Falls Resort State Park Non-electric Campsites' (29 units, $28.99 on 2026-10-27, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-18/20) + supplier 11068539 'Twin Falls Resort State Park Electric Campsites' (20 units, $39.99), read 2026-10-21

summary: Park page + booking site: fees $28.99 non-electric (+$11 electric) confirmed, non-electric sites tagged as fitting RVs; inherited booking rules (2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max) confirmed into the entry, one-night weeknights sell; added 30-amp (no site tagged 50), 50 sites, laundry.
